title.narrative: 30 Jun 2012 | Project Result / Case Study: https://www.adb.org/results/water-pda-training-program-water-tariff-reform-and-peer-peer-learning-process-rural-environmental
Loan 2648: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 17 Jun 2022

Progress Toward Outcome: The project was completed with loan account closing date as of 30 June 2017. Liquidation of imprest account is ongoing and can be concluded by 30 September 2017. The achievement of project outcome will be assessed by project completion review in Q4 2017.
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jul 2014: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//42012-013-rp-02.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42012/42012-013-smr-en.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Output 1: Improved rural roads in Fuling and Qianjiang districts and Youyang, Xiushan, Yunyang, Fengjie, Wushan, and Chengkou counties: 10 out of 11 roads construction completed and open to traffic. Construction for the new proposed Guihua Bridge to Shilongping Road of Wushan County was completed by 87% as of loan closing on 30 June 2017, and the remaining part will be completed using domestic funds by Q4 2017; 12 roads were constructed using domestic fund.
Output 2. Constructed water supply in Youyang, Yunyang, Fengjie, Wushan, and Chengkou counties: By July 2017, constructions for 6 out of 7 water supply plants were completed and started operation; Construction for Mawang Town water supply plant completed by 92% as of loan closing on 30 June 2017, the remaining part will be completed using domestic fund by Q3 2017; Caotang water supply plant in Fengjie County were constructed using domestic fund, and Hongtu Town water supply plant of Fengjie County were cancelled due to the unstable status of local water resources and pipelines were constructed to transmit water for near town.
Output 3. Enhanced project management and institutional capacity: Completed by loan closing date on 30 June 2017. The Consulting firm recruited and training workshops conducted during project implementation. Training plan developed in 2012, national training workshops and on-the-job training were carried out as scheduled. Web-based MIS which comprises project management, project performance management, and internal administration management was developed and is operating with full function.
